听到声音，计科二班所有人的目光都朝着教室门口看去，只见一名满脸欣喜的女生出现在门口，眼神充满了激动和兴奋。
女生长得很漂亮，画了淡淡的妆容，一头柔顺的长发披散开，直到臀部，她盈盈一握的蛮腰，修长笔直的双腿，对男人有致命的吸引力。
见又有极品美女出现，全班的牲口都沸腾了，可是却又很疑惑，眼前这位长发美女，到底是谁？
长发美女在众人的注目下，直接走到了陈阳跟前，笑道：“老大，怎么，不认识我了？”
“你是谁？”
陈阳皱了下眉头，还真没认出眼前这位长发美女是谁，不过不管是谁，能认识这样的美女，他是十分乐意的。
“我是聂伊辰呀。”
聂伊辰无视气得发颤的班主任杨雪薇，一屁股坐在了陈阳面前的课桌上。
听到“聂伊辰”三个字，顿时所有计科二班牲口们贪婪的目光都变成了惊悚，全都一脸惊疑地看向了长发美女，可怎么看都没办法把眼前的长发美女和那个非主流小霸王联系在一起。
“啊，你竟然是小跟班，造型一变成了大美女，我还真没认出来。”
陈阳错愕一声，上下打量着聂伊辰，发现换了装扮之后，这小妞比他料想的还要漂亮得多。
聂伊辰不好意思地挠了挠脑袋，嘿嘿笑道：“老大你让我别搞非主流，我当然听你的，所以连夜找了造型师，重新打扮了下。”
班级里的人打量着聂伊辰，终于把她的形象和曾今那个聂伊辰融合在一起，简直不敢相信自己的眼睛。
同时，同学们都十分惊讶，他们从聂伊辰看向陈阳的眼神中，竟然看到了崇拜，这个有钱、嚣张、高傲的小霸王，居然会崇拜一个骑破烂二八大杠的小子？
而且她叫陈阳老大，听陈阳的话连夜换了造型，这到底是什么情况？
难道这就是传说中的一物降一物？
杨雪薇见长发美女无视课堂纪律，她原本很生气，可是发现长发美女是聂伊辰后，她的气就消了大半。别人不知道聂伊辰的背景，但她知道，这个女孩可不是一般人惹得起，就算东安工大的校长，只怕也得看她的脸色。
“她叫陈阳老大，这是怎么回事？”杨雪薇看着一脸淡定的陈阳，心头暗道。
就在众人疑惑的时候，聂伊辰看向了坐在林柔旁边的女同学，笑了笑道：“同学，麻烦你挪一挪位置，谢谢。”
那人不敢招惹聂伊辰，点了点头，忙不迭地挪到了后排的座位。

“学委，老大，你们往里挪挪。”聂伊辰一脸笑意，对陈阳和林柔道。
林柔皱了下眉头，往右挪了个座位，陈阳坐到了林柔的位置，然后聂伊辰则是坐在了他的左侧。
聂伊辰看着故意和陈阳拉开距离的林柔，低声对陈阳道：“老大，怎么学委看起来好像很怕你呀？”
陈阳转头瞄了眼林柔，瘪了瘪嘴，对聂伊辰道：“哪里是怕我，她是怕你。”
聂伊辰面露思索之色，认真道：“不可能，我可是很支持学委工作的。”
陈阳笑道：“我估计你就没怎么来上课，这也算是支持学委工作？”
“没给她添麻烦，就算是支持了呀。”聂伊辰尴尬地笑了笑道。
见陈阳和聂伊辰低声聊着天，其他男同学都是羡慕不已，心里一阵后悔，自己怎么以前就没发现聂伊辰这么漂亮，早知如此，那就先下手了。
可是现在，人家竟然成了新同学的跟班，还唯命是从，这骑二八大杠的陈阳同学简直是太幸运了。
而且陈阳旁边还坐着清纯校花林柔，前面讲台上就是性感老师杨雪薇，当真是美女环绕，太幸福了。
上午的课程结束，林柔站起身对陈阳道：“陈阳同学，教材我去帮你拿就行，你在这里等我。”
说完，林柔没等陈阳回答，便走出了教室。
她可不想和陈阳一起去拿教材，不然指不定又得被陈阳口花花几句。
“我去上个厕所。”
陈阳给聂伊辰说了声，便走出教室，下楼骑上自己的凤凰牌二八大杠，远远的跟在了林柔的后面。
因为开学已经三个多月，教材大家都已经领到了手，教材科属于仓库，又在学校的角落，所以去教材科的路上几乎没人。
前方是一条长长的胡同，为了避免被林柔发现，陈阳藏在了拐角，探出头往胡同看。

Hearing the sound, everyone in Class 2 of the Economics Department looked towards the door of the classroom, and saw a girl with a face full of joy appearing at the door, her eyes full of excitement.
The girl was very beautiful, with light makeup, and her long, silky hair spread down to her buttocks. Her voluptuous waist and slender straight legs were fatally attractive to men.
Seeing another top beauty appear, the whole class was excited, but they were also very confused, who is this long-haired beauty in front of them?
Under the attention of everyone, the long-haired beauty walked directly to Chen Yang and said with a smile: "Boss, why don't you recognize me?"
"Who are you?"
Chen Yang frowned, he really didn't recognize who the long-haired beauty in front of him was, but no matter who she was, he was very happy to meet such a beauty.
"I'm Nie Yichen."
Nie Yichen ignored Yang Xuewei, the head teacher who was shaking with anger, and sat down on the desk in front of Chen Yang.
Hearing the three words "Nie Yichen", the greedy eyes of all the animals in the second class of the accounting department suddenly turned into horror. They all looked at the long-haired beauty with a look of surprise, but no matter how they looked, they couldn't connect the long-haired beauty in front of them with the non-mainstream little bully.
"Ah, you turned out to be a little follower. Once you transformed into a beautiful lady, I really didn't recognize you."
Chen Yang was startled and looked at Nie Yichen up and down, and found that after changing her clothes, this girl was much more beautiful than he expected.
Nie Yichen scratched his head in embarrassment and said with a smile: "Boss, you told me not to be unconventional. Of course I listened to you, so I went to a stylist overnight and dressed up again."
People in the class looked at Nie Yichen and finally merged her image with Zeng Jin's Nie Yichen. They couldn't believe their eyes.
At the same time, the students were very surprised. They saw admiration in the way Nie Yichen looked at Chen Yang. This rich, arrogant, and arrogant little bully actually worshiped a boy who rode a shabby 28-meter pole?
And her name is Boss Chen Yang. She changed her look overnight after listening to Chen Yang's words. What on earth is going on?
Could this be the legendary thing where one thing descends upon another?
Yang Xuewei was initially angry when she saw the long-haired beauty ignoring classroom discipline, but when she discovered that the long-haired beauty was Nie Yichen, her anger was mostly gone. Others don't know Nie Yichen's background, but she knows that this girl is not something ordinary people can afford to mess with. Even the principal of Dong'an University of Technology will have to look at her face.
"Her name is Boss Chen Yang. What's going on?" Yang Xuewei looked at Chen Yang who looked calm and thought to herself.
Just when everyone was confused, Nie Yichen looked at the female classmate sitting next to Lin Rou, smiled and said: "Classmate, please move your seat, thank you."
The man didn't dare to provoke Nie Yichen, so he nodded and hurriedly moved to the seat in the back row.
"Study committee, boss, please move in." Nie Yichen said to Chen Yang and Lin Judao with a smile on his face.
Lin Rou frowned and moved her seat to the right. Chen Yang sat in Lin Rou's seat, and Nie Yichen sat on his left.
Nie Yichen looked at Lin Rou who was deliberately keeping a distance from Chen Yang, and whispered to Chen Yang: "Boss, why does the school committee seem to be afraid of you?"
Chen Yang turned his head and glanced at Lin Rou, pursed his lips, and said to Nie Yichen, "She's not afraid of me, she's afraid of you."
Nie Yichen looked thoughtful and said seriously: "Impossible, I very much support the work of the school committee."
Chen Yang smiled and said: "I guess you don't come to class very often. Does this count as supporting the work of the school committee?"
"If you don't cause her any trouble, it's considered support." Nie Yichen smiled awkwardly.
Seeing Chen Yang and Nie Yichen chatting in low voices, the other male classmates were envious and felt regretful. Why had they not noticed that Nie Yichen was so beautiful before? If I had known this was the case, I would have taken action first.
But now, people actuallyBeing the new classmate's follower and obeying orders, classmate Chen Yang, who rides the 28th big bar, is simply so lucky.
Moreover, sitting next to Chen Yang was the innocent school beauty Lin Rou, and on the podium in front of him was the sexy teacher Yang Xuewei. He was really surrounded by beautiful women. He was so happy.
At the end of the morning class, Lin Rou stood up and said to Chen Yang, "Classmate Chen Yang, just let me get the textbooks for you. You wait for me here."
After saying that, Lin Rou walked out of the classroom without waiting for Chen Yang to answer.
She didn't want to go with Chen Yang to get the textbooks, otherwise she might have to be talked about by Chen Yang again.
"I'm going to use the bathroom."
Chen Yang said something to Nie Yichen, then walked out of the classroom, went downstairs and rode on his Phoenix brand 28 big stick, and followed Lin Rou from a distance.
Because it has been more than three months since school started, everyone has already received the textbooks. The textbook section belongs to the warehouse and is in the corner of the school, so there is almost no one on the way to the textbook section.
There was a long alley ahead. In order to avoid being discovered by Lin Rou, Chen Yang hid at the corner and stuck his head out to look into the alley.
